disposition_reason: The paper has no results for honey itself. Its only honey rows are 'Cereals with honey', 4 retail infant-cereal products that contain honey, with Pb and Cd in the whole cereal. These are a honey-containing composite food, not honey.
disposition_locator: Table 1 'Cadmium concentrations' row 'Cereals with honey', p.802 (PDF p.6, text-copy line 293); Table 2 'Lead concentrations' row 'Cereals with honey', p.803 (PDF p.7, text-copy line 354)

study.design: market survey of retail infant foods and cereals
study.material_scope: 63 baby food and cereal SKUs (milk powders, infant cereals including 4 'cereals with honey', miscellaneous baby foods). No plain honey.
study.growing_origin_vs_market: 'nearby supermarkets and online shops'. Country not stated; product origin not stated.
study.method: Microwave HNO3/HCl digestion; graphite-furnace AAS (Shimadzu AA-6300)
study.qa: CRMs, blanks and positive controls are said to have been run; no recovery values reported

contradictions_with_stored_summary: There is no honey-related contradiction. The wiki reports the 'cereals with honey' means (Cd 1.89, Pb 1.08 ug/kg) correctly and does not route them to honey.
unresolved: Excluded honey-containing rows, recorded for traceability and NOT honey findings. 'Cereals with honey' (n=4 products): Cd average 1.89, min 1.62, max 3.79 ug/kg, 1 below LOD (Table 1). Pb average 1.08, min blank, max 4.31 ug/kg, 3 below LOD (Table 2). The max cells wrap across two lines in the PDF ('3.7/9', '4.3/1'); the rendered page reads them as 3.79 and 4.31.

The paper is internally inconsistent. Pb is stated as above LOD in 49.21% of samples (31/63), as found 'in 46 of the tested samples', and as '45 samples', but Table 2's <LOD column sums to 40 of 63 (23 detected). Cd is stated as 12.5% below LOD, but Table 1 sums to 9/63 (14.3%). The text says milk-powder Pb had '68 below LOD' with n=22. In Table 2 the cereals Pb minimum (3.88) is above its average (3.24). The low-tier venue, with no collection period, country or numeric LODs, limits its use in any case.
